name: Nakwon: Last Paradise
storyline:
The night an asteroid passed near Earth, a meteor shower lit up the sky. At that very moment, a massive blackout plunged cities into darkness. Soon after, people across the globe started to show strange symptoms.

The infected lost their minds, lashing out and biting anyone they encountered. Infection rates soared, quickly surpassing the point of control. Governments declared official lockdowns and set up barricades in key districts. But Seoul's dense population made containment impossible; the damage from infection escalated exponentially.

Most nations abandoned and quarantined their capitals and major cities. Survivor bases, including the one in Yeouido, began to emerge. With various groups seizing control, civil unrest escalated into full-scale riots, looting, and crime. The social, political, and economic infrastructure quickly fell apart. After the official declaration of the vaccine's failure and the end of its development, the world plunged into a full-scale zombie apocalypse - beginning in the world's most densely populated cities: New York, London, Paris, Tokyo… and Seoul.

Only a few survivor bases still remain, as Yeouido stands as the largest safehaven in Seoul. Beyond its walls, scattered groups fight to survive, scraping by day to day in the ruins.
summary: NAKWON is a multiplayer zombie survival game set in urban South Korea. Venture into the city in the dead of night, and manage your shelter by day. Scavenge resources in a city crawling with the infected and hostile survivors. Survival is the only rule - trust no one, not even the living.
